title: A list item numbered through its style cannot be restarted
symptom: restart_numbering fails with "paragraph has no explicit numbering level" on the List Number paragraphs of Word and python-docx files, whose numbering comes from the style
workaround: Rust: give the paragraph its own numbering first (set_numbering with the num_id and level of effective_paragraph_properties), then restart; Python: start a new list (add_numbering_definition, add_numbering_instance, Paragraph.numbering)
